x-groups.title: S3 staging
x-groups.description: Where each epoch's rows wait, as Parquet files, for Redshift's COPY to load them. The bucket must be in the cluster's region.

x-groups.title: AWS credentials
x-groups.description: The role COPY reads the files as, and who uploads them to S3.

dsn.title: Connection string
dsn.description: A Postgres connection URL or keyword/value string to the cluster's or workgroup's endpoint and database. Redshift listens on port 5439 unless it was set otherwise; sslmode=verify-full checks its certificate.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: Used when the pipeline names no namespace. Created if missing.

bucket.title: Bucket
bucket.description: The S3 bucket the connector stages files in, in the same region as the cluster. Each file is deleted once COPY has loaded it.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: The key prefix of the staged files, such as openetl/staging. Letters, digits and !-_.*()/ only.

region.title: AWS region
region.description: The bucket's region, which must be the cluster's. Without one, the AWS default.

iamRole.title: IAM role
iamRole.description: The ARN of an IAM role associated with the cluster or workgroup that can read the staged files, which COPY assumes; roles chained with commas, or default for its default role. COPY of Parquet takes no access key, so a role is needed.

accessKeyId.title: Access key ID
accessKeyId.description: An AWS access key that uploads and deletes the staged files. Without one, the AWS default credentials where the connector runs do.

sessionToken.title: Session token
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary credentials, with accessKeyId and secretAccessKey.
